test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center of the table. Mary is second to the left of Susan. Alice is immediately adjacent to Susan and Priya. Riya is sitting third to the right of Priya. John sits second to the left of Riya. Priya is sitting second to the right of Susan. Who among the following is sitting immediately next to Mary and Susan?
solution: Given: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center of the table. 1) Mary is second to the left of Susan. 2) Priya is sitting second to the right of Susan. 3) Alice is immediately adjacent to Susan and Priya.
